facility.name: The Caterpillar Clubhouse
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 606 S MAIN ST, QUITMAN, TX, 75783

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: At the inspection,  a section of the underpinning on the side of the building is not secured and needs to be secured and replaced.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: At the inspection, one out of three children's records reviewed did not have a healthcare provider statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: At the inspection, the climbing equipment on the playground had 3 1/2 inches of gravel at the slide exit and out of compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: At the inspection, two out three children's records reviewed did not have a current immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: At the follow-up inspection, the parent has not dated the written feeding instruction for the youngest infant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: At the inspection, a fan cord and an exposed muliple plug outlet were on the floor in the classroom and accessible to children. A can of hot shot and lighter fluid was accessible to children. All was corrected at the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: At the inspection, two garbage cans were accessible to children on the playground with no lids and the contents of the trash gave off an odor and trash was laying around on the ground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: At the inspection, the documentation for the fire drills was incomplete and did not have dates, times, signatures on drills for May or June documentation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: At the inspection, the written feeding instruction for the youngest infant did not have a parent signature and was not dated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: At the inspection, the walls in the classrooms, the floors in the classroom and the walkways to and from the playground must be clean and in good repair.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: At the follow-up inspection, the fire extinguisher has not been serviced since September of 2024.     At the inspection, the fire extinguisher was tagged and last serviced in September 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): At the follow-up inspection, one employment affidavit is needed to complete the personnel file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: At the inspection, the operation violated the condition placed on the background check determination by allowing a caregiver to be left alone with a group of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: At the inspection, the training records for the staff were not in order and certificates were needing to be added for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Photo Identification: At the inspection, two out of five personnel records reviewed did not include a driver license or photo identification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Photo Identification (26 TAC §746.901(9))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: At the inspection, the emergency practice drills documentation was incomplete by not including the complete date and time, or the time of evacuation taken place.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: At the inspection, a caregiver was heard yelling at a child while playing in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): At the inspection, two out of five personnel records reviewed did not include the notarized employment affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: At the inspection, the operational policy was incomplete and unavailable for review by Child Care Regulation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: At the inspection, the fire extinguisher was tagged and last serviced in September 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: At the inspection, broken toys, chairs and trash were present on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: At the inspection, the fire inspection has expired and the last report is dated 8/31/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points: At the inspection, the wooden climbing play structure on the playground is missing two slats and has exposed screws.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points (26 TAC §746.4601(7))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training: At the inspection, the director's training record was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: This standard was evaluated as part of the investigation and found to be deficient.  The caregiver was observed to be on her cellphone prior to getting up and moving a child on a nap mat with her foot.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: This standard was evaluated as part of the investigation and found to be deficient.   The director was not maintaining compliance with the minimum standards for a safe and healthy environment for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: This standard was evaluated as part of the investigation and found to be deficient.  A caregiver was hired on 1/23/24 and started working on 1/25/24 and was handed a certificate of attending a first aid training, that was not valid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: This standard was evaluated as part of the investigation and found to be deficient.  The operation removed the paneling in the front bathroom due to a leak and had exposed beams.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records: At the follow-up inspection, the checklists are posted but no documentation has been added to the form.    At the follow-up inspection, the playground checklists have not been documented.     At the inspection, the operation has not recorded the playground maintenance checklists.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records (26 TAC §746.801(8))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records: At the follow-up inspection, the playground checklists have not been documented.     At the inspection, the operation has not recorded the playground maintenance checklists.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records (26 TAC §746.801(8))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: At the follow-up inspection, a child was present in the kitchen office area viewing a tablet and the schoolers were using tablets during the scheduled nap time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: At the follow-up inspection, clutter in the hallways and kitchen area is present, the flooring is a tripping hazard in the hallway to the playground, and stacks of materials and supplies are present.     At the inspection, the operations classrooms, hallways, staircase and kitchen is cluttered with stacks of supplies, materials, and debris.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: At the follow-up inspection, the nap room was dark and children could not be seen on the floor where they were napping.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: At the inspection, the grass on the playground is high and needs to be mowed and trash needs to be removed from the play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: At the inspection, the operational policy reviewed did not include information related to the promotion of indoor/outdoor physical activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: At the inspection, the operations classrooms, hallways, staircase and kitchen is cluttered with stacks of supplies, materials, and debris.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: At the inspection, 2 out of 5 children's records reviewed did not have an updated immunization record included in the file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: At the inspection, the operation did not have documentation of the fire, severe weather or lockdown practice drills.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: At the inspection, the annual training certificates for the caregivers/director were not available to Child Care Regulation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: At the inspection, 4 out of 5 children's records reviewed did not have the healthcare provider statement included in the file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records: At the inspection, the operation has not recorded the playground maintenance checklists.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records (26 TAC §746.801(8))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Sanitize Equipment: This standard was evaluated during the investigation inspection and found deficient.  The caregiver was observed feeding four infant's applesauce with the same spoon.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Sanitize Equipment (26 TAC §746.3317(1))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: At the follow-up inspection, four children were being pushed on the playground by a caregiver and were not strapped in the seats on the buggy.  This was corrected at inspection by removing the children from the buggy.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Gas Leak Inspection - Natural Gas: At the inspection, the current gas leak inspection is expired and is dated 1/21/21.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Gas Leak Inspection - Natural Gas (26 TAC §746.5403(a))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: At the inspection, two children were watching the TV after breakfast and are under the age of 2 years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Training Hours: At the follow-up inspection, the directors training certificates for 2021 were not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: At the follow-up inspection, two infants were not strapped into the infant equipment while being used.  The caregiver  corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements of SCPE - Installed, Maintained and Cleaned: At the follow-up inspection, the bounce house was being used by children, four children were bouncing at the same time and the bounce house is not fully enclosed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements of SCPE - Installed, Maintained and Cleaned (26 TAC §746.4953(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: At the inspection,  the 5 personnel records were not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: At the inspection, the fire inspection is dated 6/28/2021 and is expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: At the inspection, the fire extinguisher was not dated,  tagged and had not been serviced as required by manufacturer's instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect: At the inspection, the operational policy did not address all the information related to child abuse/neglect.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect (26 TAC §746.501(a)(26))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: At the inspection, the operational policy did not have information related to the indoor/outdoor physical activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))
